title: Green Bay Packers vs. Detroit Lions Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: Green Bay Packers 17-20 Detroit Lions: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: Detroit Lions won 20-17. The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
seo_description: Detroit Lions beat Green Bay Packers 20-17. EdgeDesk’s number implied Detroit Lions +2.5 — win. 4 of 10 gradeable claims held up, 3 did not. Process grade: MIXED. Research, not picks.
model_status_note: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 94 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at DraftKings on 2026-09-13, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 8 points toward Detroit Lions of the quote EdgeDesk captured at DraftKings. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 49.9 sat 0.6 points below the captured total of 50.5.

closing_line.why: no closing line is held for this game: the Collective captured none and the schedule feed carries none. Closing-line value is left blank rather than estimated from the result.

reasons: 2 claims held up, 3 held up in direction only and 3 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 5.5 and the game finished 3 the home way — 2.5 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.

verdict.line: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.
